package.name: Stock Market Recommendation System Harness

overview.title: Stock Market Recommendation System Harness
overview.summary: Supervised harness for a real-time stock research and recommendation-candidate program.
overview.usage: Import the directory, bind four agent profiles, configure market-data and web-search credentials, then preview the workflow before running.
overview.outputPolicy: Outputs are timestamped research candidates with evidence and risk review, not trade execution or personalized advice.

capabilities.description: Approved access to equity quote, OHLCV, fundamentals, market status, and optional streaming feeds.
Approved web search for current analysis methods, company catalysts, source validation, and scam/sentiment risk checks.
Optional FRED or equivalent macroeconomic data API for rates, inflation, labor, credit, and sector context.
Approval-gated write of research reports, scorecards, source logs, and verification notes.

runtimeInputs: market-data provider and API key source
